subtitleNullable: Capturing the beauty of different times of day
descriptionNullable:
The time of Day dataset is a collection of images representing different times of the day, with sunrise and sunset considered as the same category. The dataset contains images of sunrises/sunsets, daytime scenes, and nighttime scenes, and has been rescaled to 224 x 224 x 3 pixels. The images were scraped from the online photography community, Unsplash, and depict various locations and different weather conditions, such as clear skies, cloudy days etc.

The dataset is intended to be used for training and evaluating computer vision models that can recognize and classify images based on the time of day. With this dataset, you can build models that can identify the time of day and lighting conditions in an image, which can be useful for a variety of applications.

The dataset contains a total of 2671 high-quality images, carefully curated and labeled to ensure accuracy and consistency. The images are in JPEG format and have a resolution of 224 x 224 x 3 pixels. Note that the images were sourced from Unsplash and are licensed under the Unsplash License, which allows free use of the images without attribution.
The mean and standard deviation of the dataset is as follows:

|| R |G  |B |
| ---|---|
mean|0.38| 0.37 |0.37 | 
 std|0.3| 0.27 |0.28  |
